# The pill indicator is decorative within a separately labeled address pill

Accepted pill markup gives the indicator img an empty alt and initially hides it. Validation toggles it for invalid or unknown addresses and sets its tooltip; the pill receives a localized aria-label containing its address and count. Preserve the distinction between decorative icon and the containing control’s label, but the inspected source does not prove tooltip/error announcement behavior in a screen reader. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/components/compose.
